notes: Made for a firm with a list of what it does (catalogue) and people; a client with neither gets opening, statement, features, steps, quotes, contact, close.

The opening's three cells are the first three catalogue groups (else the first three features). A catalogue that is only a price list (law1: four kinds of will) makes them narrower in meaning than the firm is; selection may prefer a client whose catalogue is its services.
Bright photographs are held under a veil of the palette's dark colour strong enough for 4.5:1 on a white pixel; on the phone the opening picture is therefore faint.
drops (as written): trust[] when the client has credentials (they stand in the panel only when there are no credentials)
drops (as written): quotes beyond seven (corp1 has 11: one over the photograph, six in cells, four not shown)
drops (as written): nav items beyond five in the bar at 1440 (all of them are in the phone menu and the foot)
drops (as written): media.screens, media.phones, media.video (no place: the reference shows photographs only)
drops (as written): media.made (not used: the picture family is the client's own photography)
drops (as written): catalogue item img and group img of the 1st, 4th, 7th group (the build of those sections has no picture; the files stay free for the opening and the bands)
drops (as written): step pictures after the first usable one; project photographs after the first
drops (as written): hero.note (its phone number is shown from contact / place)
drops (as written): place.cuisine, price_range, takeaway, menu, spaces, events, notices (not a template for places)
drops (as written): photographs left over after the slots are filled (corp1: 12 of 24 unused; law1: firm-group.jpg, 1128 x 376, too small to run edge to edge)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (no made pictures)

photos_large_note: one landscape photograph at least 1600 px wide (not a portrait of a person) carries the opening; three more of that size give the statement band and the quotation band; without any the page is type on the palette's dark ground
